description: How many documents named by a freight depot's two document lists are missing from the set. DISTILL-CANARY-05c7e2af

files.README.md:
# Copperline Freight - depot operations set

Documents used by the Manchester depot and by the overnight trunk run.
The depot list and the trunk list are kept apart because the trunk crew leaves before the depot office opens.
files.guides/routing.md:
# Routing rules

Loads are planned against the overnight trunk timetable.
The trunk crew collects the consignment note from the depot office.
files.guides/customs.md:
# Customs checklist

Every trailer carries a printed declaration.
Checks are recorded on the depot handover sheet.

turns.prompt: Copperline Freight keeps its depot and trunk paperwork in two lists. How many of the documents named in those two lists have no file anywhere in the set? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
